tenderSchedule.title: Estimation for extension of LT line providing poles to long span installation at various location in Kurugodu town limits
tenderSchedule.description: Estimation for extension of LT line providing poles to long span installation at various location in Kurugodu town limits in the name of The Chief officer, Town Municipal Council, Kurugodu Tq in O&M Kurugodu section office of Kurugodu Sub division, GESCOM (Under Self execution)

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The rates should be quoted Exclusive of GST. (As per the GOVT Order FD 417 Exp- 12/2024 Dt: 09.08.2024.)
1Percent of the Tendered amount will be deducted towards Labour Welfare Fund
Contractors has to upload the EPF Registration
Contractor has to submit their labour EPF details in every R.A bills
The FSD payable at the time of executing agreement, will be refunded only after successful completion of Defects and liability period
The contractor has to establish site laboratories and should furnish the documents for having required lab testing
The increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the Contractor alone

Successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price and Additional security for unbalanced tender is in accordance with clause 44 of the conditions of contract

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 mandating satisfactory completion as a prime contractor for one Similar work (Erection of Electrical Pole work) to an extent of Rs. 3.51Lakh
Eligible GESCOM Contractor/ Inspectorate or PWD Electrical Registration certificate

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 achieved in at least Two financial years an average annual financial turnover with UDIN NO (in all classes of Govt Electrical works only) of Rs 10.00 Lakhs

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 2.10Lakhs in the form of Credit lines or Letters of Credit or Certificates from Banks for meeting the fund requirement Conditional bankers certificate Not Acceptable
